name: 建筑物（成新率/残值）评估

map.📋 建筑物（成新率/残值）评估: 📋 Building Condition Rate and Residual Value Assessment
map.基于年限法和打分法综合评估建筑物成新率与残值。年限法根据已使用年限和耐用年限计算: Assesses a building's condition rate and residual value by combining the age-life method with a scoring method. The age-life method works from elapsed and total useful life; the scoring method rates structure, fit-out and equipment, and the two are weighted together.
map.📖 查看「建筑物（成新率/残值）评估 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Building Condition Rate and Residual Value Assessment User Guide"
map.成新率 = 1 − 已用年限/经济寿命: Condition rate = 1 − elapsed years / economic life
map.年限法与打分法加权平均(各50%): Weighted average of age-life and scoring (50% each)
map.年限法和打分法是建筑物成新率评估的两种常用方法: The age-life and scoring methods are the two common approaches to assessing a building's condition rate
map.打分法权重建议：结构60%、装修20%、设备20%: Suggested scoring weights: structure 60%, fit-out 20%, equipment 20%
map.残值率为建筑物报废时的残余价值比例，一般取3%-5%: The residual value rate is the share of value remaining when the building is scrapped, usually 3%-5%
map.评估结果仅供参考，正式评估需由持证估价师执行: Results are reference only; a formal valuation must be carried out by a licensed appraiser
map.📚 深度解析：建筑物成新率与残值评估: 📚 In-depth: Building Condition Rate and Residual Value
map.或抵押贷款前估算房屋成新率与评估价值。: or estimate a building's condition rate and appraised value before taking a mortgage.
map.拆迁或保险理赔时确定建筑物实际价值与残值。: Determine the actual value and residual value of a building in demolition or insurance claims.
map.资产入账时按成新率计提折旧或重估价值。: Book assets at condition rate, applying depreciation or a revalued amount.
map.建筑原值 500 万元，耐用年限 50 年、已使用 20 年 → 年限法成新率=: Original value 5 million yuan, useful life 50 years, elapsed 20 years gives an age-life condition rate of (50−20)/50 = 40%; scoring structure, fit-out and equipment gives 55%; the average of the two is 47.5%, so appraised value = 500 × 47.5% = 2.375 million yuan and residual value = 500 × residual rate.
map.成新率对价值的影响: How the condition rate affects value
map.同样原值 500 万，已使用 10 年（成新率 80%）评估值 400 万，比已: On the same 5 million yuan original value, 10 years elapsed (80% condition rate) gives an appraised value of 4 million yuan, 1.625 million yuan less depreciation than at 20 years: a significant gap.
map.年限法和打分法哪个为准？: Which governs, the age-life or the scoring method?
map.两者各有依据，规范通常取综合（加权平均）；保养好、地段优的房产打分法会高于年限法: Both have their basis and standards usually take the weighted combination; for well maintained properties in good locations scoring runs above the age-life result, while for old run-down units the reverse holds.
map.残值率一般取多少？: What residual value rate is typical?
map.普通住宅残值率常取 0%–5%，砖混结构略高；具体按当地定额或评估指引确定。: Ordinary housing usually uses 0%-5%, with brick-concrete slightly higher; follow the local quota or appraisal guidance.
map.关于「建筑物（成新率/残值）评估」: About "Building Condition Rate and Residual Value Assessment"
map.建筑物成新率评估工具综合年限法和打分法计算建筑物成新率，年限法根据已使用年限和耐: This building condition rate tool combines the age-life method (elapsed and useful life) with scoring across structure, fit-out and equipment, weighting the two to produce a condition rate and appraised value.
